content.text: {"primary_meaning":"A “name” most commonly symbolizes the identity and revealed character of the person who bears it; in biblical usage it can therefore represent the person himself or herself, including that person’s presence, reputation, and authority. God’s name especially signifies God as revealed and made known.","primary_basis":["Exodus 3:13–15 — God’s revealed name is associated with his identity and covenantal self-disclosure.","Exodus 34:5–7 — the LORD proclaims his name by declaring his character and attributes.","Psalm 20:7 — trusting in the name of the LORD means trusting in God himself.","Proverbs 18:10 — the name of the LORD represents God’s protective presence and power.","Matthew 1:21–23 — Jesus’ names identify his mission and significance.","John 17:6, 26 — Jesus makes the Father’s name known, commonly understood as revealing God’s person and character.","Philippians 2:9–11 — the exalted name of Jesus signifies supreme status and authority."],"alternatives":[{"meaning":"Delegated authority or agency: acting “in
